snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 – Siege Mode Teaser
snippet.description:
Teased during Warhammer Skulls Festival livestream, the “Siege” update brings an endless new PvE game mode, alongside two new cosmetic DLCs, coming June 26.

Focus Entertainment and Saber Interactive are excited to announce the release date and reveal the first gameplay footage for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2’s long-awaited Siege mode. Available for free to all PlayStation 5, Xbox Series and PC players on June 26, the “Siege” update comes with a new PvE game mode and two new cosmetics DLCs for Season Pass owners.
